title: [Vyral] Auto Catch , Auto Run , God Mode and more!
features:
Features

Runner: Auto Cross, crossing presets, gem collection, catcher avoidance, Auto Rescue, Auto Dodge, Auto Dash, Auto Clone and automatic role choices.

Catcher: Auto Catch, optional player selection, targeting modes, Back Lock or Chase, movement prediction, Dive Tackle and adjustable catch timing.

Tackle Controls: Tackle Aim, adjustable reach, aim angle, prediction lead and Auto Tackle.

Lobby: Auto Vote, favorite maps, random or least-voted selection, vote delay, Auto Join, Anti-AFK and Skip Tutorial.

Movement: Walk, Velocity and Tween methods, movement presets, custom speed, arrival distance, height offset and reset fallback.

Player Mods: Speed Boost, speed multiplier, instant acceleration, Noclip, full-length dash and local dash cooldown controls.

Gear: Auto Self Rescue, Auto Gear Use, enemy-based activation, Auto Equip Best Gear and automatic gem ability purchases with a configurable reserve.

Webhooks: Successful-run, catch and periodic stats logs, plus a test-message button.

Interface: Quick-start controls, saved settings, clear tooltips and a floating menu button.
